cohort: The study included 80 adult patients (42 women and 38 men) with drug-resistant epilepsy (DRE) and non-lesional MRI findings who underwent epilepsy surgery.
finding: The seizure freedom rate was highest for extratemporal surgery (83.33%), followed by temporal surgery (62.7%), corpus callosotomy (26.66%), and none for Vagus nerve stimulation.
